Filtra pelo resultado do item: `applied`: Filter by item result: applied or failed.
Tipo de linha para o qual os DDDs são co: Line type to list area codes for: mobile (mobile line) or mobile-did (virtual number). One type per request.
Filtra pelos DDDs com (`true`) ou sem (`: Whether to return only area codes with a number available right now (on) or only those without one (off).
Idempotency key for this request. Will r: Idempotency key for this request. Will return the same response if the same request is made again with the same key. Fails if parameters are different.
Nome do grupo de linhas. Único na empres: Group name. Unique within the company, ignoring case and accents: "Sales SP" and "sales sp" are the same group.
Cor do grupo de linhas. Quando omitida,: Group color. Defaults to cyan when omitted.
Nome do grupo de linhas. Não pode repeti: Group name. Must not repeat another group's name in the company, ignoring case and accents.
Sufixo do ICCID (7 a 10 dígitos) ou ICCI: ICCID suffix (7 to 10 digits) or full ICCID of the new physical SIM. Only send it when reactivating a physical-SIM line with a corrected SIM; eSIM lines must not send this field.
IDs das linhas que recebem o centro de c: IDs of the phone accounts that receive the cost center, up to 1,000 per request. All must belong to your company; if any does not, none is changed. Repeated IDs count once.
ID do centro de custo aplicado às linhas: ID of the cost center applied to the phone accounts (see Cost Center > Get Many). Leave empty to remove the cost center from the phone accounts.
Reason for blocking the phone account.
Detalhamento do motivo. Obrigatório quan: Reason details. Required when Reason is Other.
Quando a linha é cancelada. \"immediate\: When the phone account is canceled. Immediate cancels right away. Scheduled keeps it working until the end of the current billing cycle and cancels it on that date. Only an active phone account can have its cancellation scheduled. In both cases the current month is billed.
Reason for canceling the phone account.
Detalhamento do motivo. Obrigatório quan: Reason details. Required when Reason is Other. Maximum of 248 characters.
Area code (DDD) of the phone account.
Nome da linha, definido pelo cliente par: Phone account name, set by you to make management easier.
ID do centro de custo da linha; consultá: ID of the phone account's cost center (see Cost Center > Get Many).
ID do grupo de linhas em que a linha ent: ID of the phone account group the line joins (see Phone Account Group > Get Many).
ID do colaborador associado à linha. Dev: ID of the employee associated with the phone account. Must belong to the same company as the API key.
Custom fields for the phone account. Fields must be created beforehand in the Salvy dashboard (https://app.salvy.com.br/settings/custom-fields); unknown labels are ignored.
Chave de idempotência da requisição. Uma: Idempotency key for this request. A new call with the same key returns the phone account already created instead of creating another one.
ICCID (ou seus últimos 7 a 10 dígitos) d: ICCID (or its last 7 to 10 digits) of the physical SIM used to activate the line.
ID do plano de assinatura contratado pel: ID of the subscription plan for the line (see Plan > Get Many).
ID do colaborador associado à linha. Dev: ID of the employee associated with the phone account. Must belong to the same company as the API key. Leave empty to remove the association.
ID do centro de custo da linha; consultá: ID of the phone account's cost center (see Cost Center > Get Many). Leave empty to remove it.
Filtra mensagens recebidas a partir dest: Only messages received from this date on (inclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra mensagens recebidas até esta data: Only messages received before this date (exclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra mensagens cujo serviço detectado: Only messages whose detected service is in the list. Use __null__ to include messages with no detected service.
Filtra pelo status público da linha. Rep: Filter by the phone account's public status.
Filtra pelo tipo de produto da linha. Re: Filter by the phone account's product type.
Filtra pelo número que o cliente reconhe: Filter by the number the customer knows as the line's, in E.164 format: matches the active number, the number chosen or being ported before activation, and the number of an ongoing or failed port-in. A line can match a number it does not display (e.g. a canceled line whose port-in never completed), so compare with phoneNumber in the result.
Filtra pelas linhas associadas aos colab: Filter by phone accounts associated with these employees.
Filtra pelo centro de custo da linha. Re: Filter by the phone account's cost center. Use __null__ for phone accounts without a cost center.
Filtra linhas criadas a partir desta dat: Phone accounts created from this date on (inclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra linhas criadas até esta data (exc: Phone accounts created before this date (exclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra linhas ativadas a partir desta da: Phone accounts activated from this date on (inclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra linhas ativadas até esta data (ex: Phone accounts activated before this date (exclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra linhas canceladas a partir desta: Phone accounts canceled from this date on (inclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra linhas canceladas até esta data (: Phone accounts canceled before this date (exclusive), ISO 8601.
Campo usado para ordenar o resultado. Pa: Field used to sort the results. Default: createdAt.
Conteúdo da mensagem SMS simulada, até 1: Content of the simulated SMS, up to 160 characters.
Número de origem do SMS simulado (short: Origin number of the simulated SMS (A2P short code or alphanumeric sender).
Quantidade de dados a adicionar à linha,: Amount of data to add to the phone account, in gigabytes.
Colaboradores a criar ou atualizar, até: Employees to create or update, up to 1,000 per request, each with a distinct integrationId. The request body is limited to 1 MB; split larger syncs into several requests.
ID do centro de custo do colaborador (ve: ID of the employee's cost center (see Cost Center > Get Many). Returns 404 if the cost center does not exist in the company.
Filtra pelo tipo de contrato do colabora: Filter by employee contract type. Use __null__ for employees without a contract type.
Filtra pelo CPF exato do colaborador. Ac: Filter by the employee's exact CPF. Accepts formatted (with punctuation) or digits only.
Filtra colaboradores admitidos a partir: Employees admitted from this date on (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.
Filtra colaboradores admitidos até esta: Employees admitted before this date (exclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. To include a whole day, use the next day (e.g. 2026-06-01 to include all of 2026-05-31).
Filtra colaboradores desligados a partir: Employees terminated from this date on (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.
Filtra colaboradores desligados até esta: Employees terminated before this date (exclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. To include a whole day, use the next day (e.g. 2026-06-01 to include all of 2026-05-31).
ID do centro de custo do colaborador (ve: ID of the employee's cost center (see Cost Center > Get Many). Set another ID to change it, or leave empty to remove it. Returns 404 if the cost center does not exist in the company.
Endereço do colaborador. Envie `null` pa: Employee address. Clearing the address through this node is not supported.
Código do centro de custo definido pela: Cost center code defined by your company.
Situação do centro de custo: \"active\": Cost center status: active (in use) or disabled (disabled by the company). Defaults to active when omitted.
ID do centro de custo em que este fica a: ID of the cost center this one is nested under. Leave empty to keep it at the root.
Tipo do centro de custo: \"standard\" (p: Cost center type: standard or project (a project of the parent cost center).
Data em que o centro de custo é desativa: Date on which the cost center is disabled automatically.
ID do colaborador responsável pelo centr: ID of the employee responsible for the cost center.
Centro de custo que recebe as linhas e o: Cost center that receives the phone accounts and employees linked to the deleted one. Leave empty to leave them without a cost center.
Situação do centro de custo: \"active\": Cost center status: active (in use) or disabled (disabled by the company).
ID do colaborador responsável pelo centr: ID of the employee responsible for the cost center. Leave empty to remove the current responsible employee.
Filtra pela situação da fatura. Repita o: Filter by invoice status. Late is derived: matches open invoices past their due date.
Filtra faturas de um mês de referência e: Invoices for a specific reference month, YYYY-MM. Cannot be combined with From Month Year / To Month Year.
Filtra faturas com mês de referência a p: Invoices with reference month from this month on (inclusive), YYYY-MM.
Filtra faturas com mês de referência até: Invoices with reference month up to this month (inclusive), YYYY-MM.
Campo usado para ordenar o resultado. Pa: Field used to sort the results. Default: dueDate.
Texto da anotação a ser registrada na li: Text of the note to record on the timeline.
Asset tag (enrollment number) of the asset.
Categoria do equipamento. Uma categoria: Asset category. A category with this name is created automatically if it does not exist yet.
Preço de aquisição do equipamento, em ce: Acquisition price of the asset, in cents.
Número da nota fiscal de aquisição do eq: Number of the acquisition invoice (NF-e) of the asset.
Identificador do contrato relacionado ao: Identifier of the contract related to the asset.
Situação do equipamento. O valor `archiv: Asset status. Archived is not accepted on creation; archive the asset with Asset > Archive after creating it.
ID do colaborador ao qual o equipamento: ID of the employee the asset is assigned to. Must belong to the same company as the API key.
Data de vinculação do colaborador ao equ: Date the employee was attached to the asset.
Incluir equipamentos arquivados na respo: Whether to include archived assets in the response (default: false).
Filtra pela situação do equipamento. Rep: Filter by asset status. Does not include archived; use Include Archived to bring archived assets.
Filtra pela categoria exata do equipamen: Filter by exact asset category. Use __null__ for assets without a category.
Filtra equipamentos pelos colaboradores: Filter by the employees the assets are attached to. Use __null__ for assets without an employee.
Filtra pelo número de série exato do equ: Filter by exact asset serial number.
Filtra pelo número de patrimônio exato d: Filter by exact asset tag (enrollment number).
Filtra equipamentos criados a partir des: Assets created from this date on (inclusive), ISO 8601.
Filtra equipamentos criados até esta dat: Assets created before this date (exclusive), ISO 8601.
Situação do equipamento. O valor `archiv: Asset status. Archived is not accepted here; use Asset > Archive or Asset > Unarchive.
ID do colaborador ao qual o equipamento: ID of the employee the asset is assigned to. Must belong to the same company as the API key. Leave empty to remove the association.
Data de vinculação do colaborador ao equ: Date the employee was attached to the asset. Removed automatically if the employee is detached.
Filtra os termos que incluem algum dos e: Only statements that include any of these assets.
Filtra os termos assinados (ou a serem a: Only statements signed (or to be signed) by these employees.
Termo de responsabilidade, enviado na en: Responsibility statement, sent when the assets are handed over. The signer is the employee the assets are assigned to; all assets must be assigned to the same employee.
IDs dos equipamentos listados no termo,: IDs of the assets listed in the statement, up to 6. All must belong to the same company.
Termo de devolução, enviado quando o col: Return statement, sent when the employee returns the assets.
ID do colaborador que devolve os equipam: ID of the employee who returns the assets and signs the statement. Must belong to the same company as the assets.
Situação do equipamento após o desarquiv: Asset status after unarchiving. Required: unarchiving does not restore the asset's previous status.
